title: Classic POLYLINE closed-N topology flag guard
scope: Prevent classic POLYLINE output from combining the closed-N modifier with a non-mesh parent, which emitted a 2D parent with polygon-mesh VERTEX subclasses.

authority.finding: Group 70 bit 16 identifies a 3D polygon mesh; bit 32 identifies closure in the N direction. The writer must not treat bit 32 as an independent vertex family.

implementation.change: DRW_Polyline::validateVertexTypesDxf now refuses group-70 bit 32 unless bit 16 is also set. The guard is output-only; input remains tolerant. The existing role-closure selector now verifies destination-preserving refusal for bit 32 alone, same-adapter correction/retry, and positive output/readback for a mesh with flags 16|32.
implementation.fixturePolicy: Test drawings are authored in memory and temporary ASCII/Binary outputs are removed; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

focusedTests.result: PASS 1/1; ASCII and Binary refusal, destination preservation, same-adapter retry, typed readback, invalid closed-N rejection, and valid closed-N polygon mesh.
PASS 1/1; neighboring classic WCS extrusion guard remains intact.

validation.fullSuites: NOT RUN; focused fast selectors only.

limits: This closes one malformed output topology combination; it does not qualify polygon-mesh geometry semantics or native consumer behavior.
No producer-wide, platform, or general 3D support claim is established.
